data.description:
Docker Compose dev stack with hot reload for both halves, health-gated startup, and a smoke target. Spec: docs/SPEC.md §10, §11, §2 (versions).

Why: the owner asked for Docker Compose on the latest versions, and the interview addendum says the environment must be running on the laptop with no setup time lost. One command brings up a reloading stack; `make smoke` proves it in seconds.

Scope:
- backend/Dockerfile.dev: golang:1.27-alpine, CGO_ENABLED=0, installs air, workdir /app, module cache in a named volume. backend/.air.toml watching *.go and rebuilding ./cmd/api.
- Web service on node:24-alpine (a Dockerfile.dev only if a plain image command is not enough): bind-mount ./frontend, anonymous volume for node_modules, `npm ci && npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0`.
- compose.yaml per §10: api with env from §11 (DB_PATH=/data/listings.db, LISTINGS_FILE=/data/sample_listings.json, CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173), ./data bind-mounted, port 8080, healthcheck wget /healthz; web with VITE_API_PROXY_TARGET=http://api:8080, port 5173, depends_on api service_healthy.
- Makefile: up (docker compose up), down (docker compose down -v), smoke.
- scripts/smoke.sh: bring the stack up detached, wait for api health (bounded retries), GET /api/cities and assert it contains Springfield, GET /api/listings/search?targetBudget=450000&city=Springfield and assert items non-empty and the first rank is 1, GET with minPrice=5&maxPrice=1 and assert 400 and code min_gt_max, GET http://localhost:5173 and assert 200 with the title Brillio Listings, then tear down. Plain sh with curl and grep; no jq dependency.
- Confirm that saving a Go file restarts api inside the container and saving a TSX file hot-reloads the page.

Acceptance:
- From a clean checkout `docker compose up` reaches healthy api and a reachable web on :5173 that proxies to api.
- `make smoke` passes and exits 0; `make down` leaves no containers or volumes behind.
- Go and TSX edits reload without restarting compose.

Validation: run `make smoke` and paste the output; open http://localhost:5173 served by compose and perform one search in the browser; attach both with --role validation.
data.title: Docker Compose dev stack with hot reload, health gating, and make smoke

data.body: Orchestrator 02:10Z: linked depends_on BC-5 — make smoke asserts /api/cities and /api/listings/search behavior that only exists after BC-5. Press-ahead exception (run-state decision log): BC-13 builds now on feat/BC-7 + master (BC-2 landed); its compose/air/proxy/health parts are validated now, and the full make smoke validation plus landing wait until BC-5 lands on master.

plan-review fallback: headless lattice plan-review hit the 600 s watchdog (exit 142; review-status: dead holder pid, no result). Fresh-context Opus plan-review sub-agent ran instead; verdict APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES, attached with --role plan-review.

Plan-review triage (cycle 1): 9 obvious findings folded into the plan's AUTHORITATIVE Resolutions block (smoke teardown-failure exit status + uninterruptible cleanup; dump compose logs on assertion failure and clear stale bodies; validation cold build via 'docker compose build --no-cache api'; browser-search fallback must be recorded in evidence + comment + LAND-READY if BC-12 is not on master; cheap stage-1 SQLite WAL bind-mount probe; raw-body grep for title/text assertions; BC-7-landed wording; brillio-label volume check; excludesFile=/dev/null status). 1 evolutionary skipped: every make smoke / make up after make down starts cold because down -v wipes the gomod/gobuild named volumes (binding decision: down is exactly 'docker compose down -v'); expect 1-3 min smoke runs once BC-4's modernc sqlite is in the build — follow-up only if it hurts live. 0 complex findings.

SPEC edit: §3 (commit a0bc111 on feat/BC-13-compose-stack) — dropped frontend/Dockerfile.dev from the frontend/ listing, because §10 and BC-13 run the web service on the stock node:24-alpine image with a command: (no Dockerfile needed); added scripts/smoke.sh to the root listing, since it backs make smoke (§10).

Implementation verified by delegator: commits c22bda2, e816e45, a0bc111 (+339/-4, 6 files); make check exit 0 (golangci-lint 0 issues; go test 3 pkgs ok; vitest 2 files / 4 tests), sh -n + shellcheck clean, docker compose config -q ok, tree clean with excludesFile=/dev/null. Accepted deviation: the operator's shell exports DOCKER_DEFAULT_PLATFORM=linux/amd64 (plus DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0, COMPOSE_DOCKER_CLI_BUILD=0), which makes plain 'docker compose up' fail with an arm64/amd64 image platform mismatch on this host. make up and scripts/smoke.sh unset DOCKER_DEFAULT_PLATFORM; compose.yaml stays architecture-neutral; down stays exactly 'docker compose down -v'. Validation runs raw compose commands as 'env -u DOCKER_DEFAULT_PLATFORM docker compose ...' (plan Implementation Notes).

own-reviewer fallback: headless lattice code-review (base master, head feat/BC-13-compose-stack @bfdd206) hit the 600 s watchdog (exit 142; review-status: dead holder pid 8665, no result). Fresh-context Opus reviewer sub-agent is reviewing instead.

Review cycle 1 routing (PASS-WITH-NITS, art_01M4W7W86PYZ5PJCCXHKK525WR): all 4 findings -> fix via implementer sub-agent (curl -q --noproxy '*' on every smoke curl; HUP trap + uninterruptible cleanup incl. HUP; printf for body excerpts; backend/.dockerignore '*' because the operator's DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0 classic builder sends the whole context). Then re-review so the PASS names the new HEAD.

own-reviewer fallback (cycle 2): headless lattice code-review at 95b937f (diff 350 lines, load ~11, so headless was tried first per run-state 03:22Z) hit the 600 s watchdog again (exit 142). Fresh-context Opus reviewer sub-agent re-reviewing the full branch diff at 95b937f, including the 4 cycle-1 nit fixes (9c40f38, 902012e) and the master merge (BC-11).

Review cycle 2 routing (PASS-WITH-NITS, cycle-2 artifact at 95b937f): cycle-1 findings all verified fixed. New Minor (smoke.sh cleanup under set -e skips down -v when stdout is dead) -> fix via implementer sub-agent (set +e in cleanup, add PIPE to the ignored signals), then re-review. This is fix->re-review cycle 2 of the 2-cycle cap; any further finding escalates. Plan aside (stale .dockerignore note) corrected.

Cycle-2 fix done: aa7b924 (set +e in smoke cleanup, PIPE ignored during teardown) + 0572560 (trap 'exit 141' PIPE in the main body; closes the dash 'smoke.sh | head -c 1' case the implementer found on the same finding). Stub harness A-E all tear down under sh and dash. Merged master c2e5544 (BC-5 landed) -> HEAD 21cd239; make check exit 0 (5 Go pkgs ok, vitest 13 files / 228 tests), sh -n, shellcheck, compose config ok. Final review: fable sub-agent per run-state decision 04:02Z.

Review cycle 3 routing: PASS at 21cd239 with no findings. Non-blocking notes: (a) SPEC §3 layout does not list backend/.dockerignore — skipped: a one-word doc touch-up that would move HEAD off the reviewed sha for no behavior change; BC-15 (README) or the next SPEC touch can add it. (b) master gained BC-10 (frontend only, no overlap with BC-13 files) — not merged before validation so review and validation name the same HEAD; Orchestrator's landing re-review rule applies.

BC-13 complete, LAND-READY sent (HEAD 21cd239). Built: compose.yaml (name: brillio; api = golang:1.27-alpine + air v1.67.4 via backend/Dockerfile.dev, CGO_ENABLED=0, ./backend + ./data bind mounts, gomod/gobuild named volumes, all six SPEC §11 env vars, wget /healthz healthcheck with 180 s start_period; web = node:24-alpine, npm ci && vite dev on 0.0.0.0:5173 strictPort, anonymous node_modules volume, VITE_API_PROXY_TARGET=http://api:8080, depends_on api service_healthy, own healthcheck; polling watchers via air poll=true and CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING; init: true), backend/.air.toml, backend/.dockerignore, scripts/smoke.sh (POSIX sh, curl/grep only, preflight never tears down an existing stack, 8 assertions incl. both proxy checks, always tears down via EXIT/INT/TERM/HUP/PIPE traps, logs dumped on failure, teardown failure -> exit 1), Makefile BC-13 block (up/down/smoke; down = docker compose down -v). Deviations: SPEC edit §3 (no frontend/Dockerfile.dev, scripts/smoke.sh listed); make up + smoke.sh unset the operator's DOCKER_DEFAULT_PLATFORM=linux/amd64 (compose.yaml stays arch-neutral). Reviews: cycle 1 PASS-WITH-NITS (4 hardening nits fixed), cycle 2 PASS-WITH-NITS (teardown under set -e with dead stdout; fixed + SIGPIPE trap), cycle 3 PASS (fable) at 21cd239. Validation PASS at 21cd239: fresh clone cold build, healthy in 21 s, proxy verified, Go reload 2 s and TSX HMR 1 s without container restarts, make smoke 8/8 exit 0, guard refuses an existing stack, make down leaves no containers/volumes/networks; SQLite WAL on the bind mount works. Browser search used the plan fallback (BC-12 SearchPage not on master). Skipped notes: SPEC §3 does not list backend/.dockerignore (doc-only; BC-15 or next SPEC touch); every make smoke/make up after make down starts cold by design (down -v wipes Go caches). No follow-up tickets created.
